title: Simple Past: Regular and Irregular Verbs / Isikhathi esidlule: Izincazelo ezihlobene nakanye nezihlobene
bridge: NgesisiZulu, isikhathi esidlule sinezicelo eziqondile (ngihambile, ngadli, ngahlala). NgesiNgisi, izincazelo ezihlobene zenzelela -ed (talk → talked), kodwa izincazelo eziningi eziphambili ziyahlobene kabi futhi ziguqula kabi (go → went). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi le ndlela iyafanayo nakuzo zonke izinsizi (I went, you went, he went), ngesisiZulu iyalahlwa (ngiyahamba, uyahamba, uyahamba). Qaphela ukungasebenzisi isikhathi esithi 'did' emizuzweni eyiqondile!
rule: Isikhathi esidlule ngesiNgisi sisetshenziselwa izenzo eziphelele ngesikhathi esicacileyo esidlule. Kuzincazelo ezihlobene, kuzenzelwa -ed (work → worked, play → played). Uma incazelo iyaphela nga-'e', kuzenzelwa -d kuphela (live → lived); uma iphela ngesikhombisa + 'y', 'y' iyalahlwa 'i' futhi kuzenzelwa -ed (study → studied). Izincazelo ezihlobene zinezicelo zazo (see → saw, eat → ate) okudingeka ukuzikhumbuza. Ezinye izinto nezibuzo, kusetshenziselwa isikhathi esithi 'did' + umzekelo we-incazelo (I didn't go, Did you see?). Ukuqonda akusebenzisi 'did'. Isikhathi esidlule isetshenziselwa nezitshebo njengokuthi 'yesterday', 'last week', 'in 2010'.

concept_examples.text: I walked to the park yesterday.
She ate an apple for breakfast.
We didn't watch TV last night.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈdɪdnt wɑːtʃ tiː ˈviː læst naɪt/

common_error.explanation: Lolu phutha lweyo ngenxa yokuthi ngesiZulu kuqondileka incazelo ephambili (akaye), kodwa ngesiNgisi, ukusebenzisa 'did' (isikhathi esidlule), incazelo ephambili iyabuyela ekwenzekeni yaso: 'go'. Khumbula: 'did' seyisibonisa isikhathi esidlule, ngakho-ke incazelo ayiqondakali.

examples.note: Kuzenzelwa -ed encazelo 'play' ukuze kuvele 'played'.
Uma incazelo iphela ngesikhombisa + 'y', iyalahlwa 'i' futhi kuzenzelwa -ed: study → studied.

title: Present Progressive (Isikhathi esimanje)
bridge: NgesiNgisi, isikhathi esimanje (am/is/are + isikhathi -ing) siyathusa ukwenza izinto eziyenzekayo ngoku qha nekhathini eliseka. NgisiZulu, siyathusa isikhathi esijulile ukwenza izinto eziyenzekayo ngoku qha nekhathini eliseka (''ngiyakhuluma'' vs ''ngikhuluma''). Umphumela omkhulu ngokuthi abantu abakhuluma isiZulu bayakukhohlwa ukusebenzisa isikhathi esimanje ''to be'' okanye baya kukhathaza ukusebenzisa isikhathi esijulile vs esimanje. Ngokungalinzanga kansiZulu, isiNgisi iyahlukanisa kakhulu phakathi kwesimo esijulile (isikhathi esijulile) nesimo esimanje (isikhathi esimanje).
rule: Isikhathi esimanje siyakusebenzisa isikhathi ''to be'' esehlulelwe (am, is, are) + isikhathi esikhulu nesiphetho -ing. Siyathusa ukwenza: 1) izinto eziyenzekayo ngoku qha (''I am reading now''), 2) izinto eziyenzekayo ngoku qha (''She is working in Madrid these days''), futhi 3) izinhlelo zokufika (''We are meeting at 5''). Asiyikusebenzisa nezihloko zokwazi (like, want, know, prefer) ngaphandle kwesikhathi esihle. Ukuhlula uyakwenza ''not'' emva kwesikhathi esimanje (''I am not sleeping''), futhi ukubuza uyakuhlula isikhathi esimanje (''Are you listening?''). NgisiZulu, isikhathi esimanje (ukuba + isikhathi esimanje) siyafana, kodwa isiNgisi siyathusa kabanzi kunaleyo yasiZulu, kakhulu ukwenza izinto eziyenzekayo ngoku qha.

concept_examples.text: I am studying English now.
She is working in Madrid.
We are having dinner.
Are you listening to me?

common_error.explanation: Lolu phumela lwenze ngenxa yokuthi ngisiZulu asiyengezi isiphetho esikhathi lapho siyathusa isikhathi esimanje (''ngiyasebenza'' vs ''ngiyasebenza''). NgisiNgisi, emva kwesikhathi esimanje ''to be'' siyakwenza isikhathi nesiphetho -ing. Ukuba ufuna ukulucula, khumbula umqondo: umphathi + am/is/are + isikhathi-ing. Ungakhohlwa isiphetho -ing.

examples.note: Sebenzisa 'am' ne 'I'.
Sebenzisa 'is' ne he, she, it.
Sebenzisa 'are' ne you, we, they.
Khumbula ukuhlahla 'y' ukuze ungeze -ing (watch > watching).
Ukuhlula uyakusebenzisa 'am not', 'is not', 'are not'.
Isiqondiso esihle: isn't.
Hlula umphathi nesikhathi esimanje ukuze ubuze.
Imibuzo yezinhlobo zokubuza iyakwenza isikhathi esimanje emva kwesikhathi esibuza.

title: Future with going to / Isizulu 'going to'
bridge: Kwisizulu, ukuze sicazise imicabango yesiwanguko sixoxa isikhathi esivela ngoku ('ngosuku lwangomso ngiya edikini') noma isisho 'ya + infinitive' ('ngosuku lwangomso ngizokuya edikini'). NgesiNgisi, isishwankathelo 'be going to + verb' yisilinganiso esisodwa soku 'ya + infinitive', kodwa inezahluko ebalulekile: ngesiNgisi ufuna isisho 'to be' (am/is/are) ngaphambi kuka 'going to', okungasekuziseki isizulu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, 'going to' sixoxwa imicabango nemisebenzi, kodwa akusetshenziswa ukuphenya okudla ngokubona okwenzekile (ngelinye ihlu lakho kusetshenziswa 'will').
rule: Ukuwudala isikhathi esizayo nge 'going to', kusetshenziswa: umphathi + isisho 'to be' (am/is/are) + 'going to' + isisho ngendlela eyodwa. Ekuphawuleni: 'I am going to travel' (ngizokuhamba). Ekungavumelweni: 'I am not going to travel' (angizokuhamba). Ekubuzweni: 'Are you going to travel?' (uyizokuhamba?). Kusonjululiwe ngokuthi: 'I'm going to', 'You're going to', njll. Kusetshenziswa ukuze: 1) Imicabango nemisebenzi eyazalwe ngaphambi (ngizokufunda isikhathi eside), 2) Ukuphenya okubona ngokubona (Bheka lawe amafu! Izokuhla). Akusetshenziswa ukuthwebula izinqumo eziphathelene (kusetshenziswa 'will': 'ngizokunceda'). Khumbula ukuthi 'going to' akayiguquli, kuphela 'to be' okuguqulwa.

title: Simple Future (will) / Isizanga Esiyofika (will)
bridge: NgisiZulu, ukuze sicazise isizanga esiyofika, siyathusa isizanga esimfihleko (ngizokudla, ngizoya) noma isifungo 'siza + isifundo'. NgesiNgisi, indlela engakwazi ngayo ukusetshenziswa kwezizanga ezifiki ngokweqhubeka yile 'will + isifundo sendaba', engaphindishiwanga ngokomuntu. Ngokungafaniyo nesiZulu, akukho ukuhlanjululwa okwengeziwe ngomuntu; isifundo sahlala njengasinjalo. Isixandu esikwaziyo ngakho yikukhohlwa ukuthi emva kwesi 'will' kusetshenziswa isifundo sendaba sesifundo, ngaphandle kwesi 'to' noma '-s' ngomuntu wesithathu.
rule: Isizanga esiyofika neso 'will' siyakhiwa ngomuntu + will (noma ukuhlanjululwa 'll) + isifundo ngendlela eyiyindaba. Akukho ukuhlehliswa ngomuntu (he will go, she will go, we will go). Ukuze ubeke ukungavi, kusetshenziswa will not (won't). Ngemibuzo, isiphetho siyahlehliswa: Will + umuntu + isifundo sendaba. Kusetshenziswa 'will' ukuze kuthathwe imibuto eziphambili, ukubekwa kwemibuto, ukubeka kwemibuto, ukubeka kwemibuto nokubonisa ukuthanda. Kusetshenziswa nangokwezindlela zosizo lwesizanga njengengomso, iviki elilandelayo, ngesikhathi eside, njll. Ngokungavi, isimo esikhethekile yile 'will not' nokuhlanjululwa yile 'won't'.

title: Comparatives and Superlatives / Izibonakalisi nezokuncinane
bridge: NesiNgisi, ukuze sikhethe izibonakalisi nezokuncinane, siyamisa 'more' ne 'less' ngokuvamile (more tall, the most tall). NesiNgisi, kukhona izindawo ezimbili: ngesibonelo, amazwi acothula (okomnyango omnye, ngenkathi imbili) siyekela '-er' ne '-est' (tall → taller → tallest), ngesikhathi amazwi amandla (okomnyango ombili noma okuningi) siyamisa 'more' ne 'most' (beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful). Isiphambeko esikhulu: ungasho 'more tall' ukusho 'más alto' — lokho kuvele khona kakhulu nesiNgisi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, nezokuncinane siyekela 'the' (the tallest), ngesikhathi nesiSipeyini ngenkathi kungaba yimphara 'el'.
rule: Ngezibonakalisi zokudlula: Amazwi acothula (okomnyango omnye nanjengoba 'happy', 'simple') siyekela '-er' (fast → faster). Amazwi amandla (okomnyango ombili noma okuningi) siyamisa 'more' (more expensive). Ngezokuncinane: '-est' (the fastest) noma 'most' (the most expensive). Amazwi amandla amabili anokomnyango ombili ayekela -y ahamba ku -ier ne -iest (happy → happier → happiest). Ezinye izibonakalisi: good/well → better → best; bad → worse → worst; far → farther/further → farthest/furthest. Siyamisa 'than' ngezibonakalisi (She is taller than me) ne 'the' + isibonakalisi (He is the best). Asiyekeli 'more' ne '-er', noma 'most' ne '-est'.

She is more intelligent than her brother.

title: Modal Verbs: must, have to, should
bridge: Ngesi, siyaqamba 'must', 'have to' kanye 'should' ukuze sbonise ukubalulekile kanye nokukhothalaza, kodwa nge-English, amazwi akhethekayo ashinana ngendlela kuya ngokwesikhathi nomuntu. Lapha, 'must' kanye 'have to' zifanayo kodwa kunezahlukahluku ezincane ngokubalulekile komuntu noma okusuka phandle, kanti 'should' siyathusa ukuze siphe ukukhothalaza. Qaphela: nge-English, amazwi akhethekayo awuthathi 's' kwabantu abathathu futhi landelana ngezwi elingekayo ngaphandle kuka 'to'.
rule: Amazwi akhethekayo nge-English athathwa ukuze abonise ukubalulekile (must, have to), ukukhothalaza (should) kanye nokudingeka (need to). Ukusebenzisa izinqubo, siyathusa: umuntu + okhethekayo + izwi elingekayo (ngaphandle kuka 'to', ngaphandle kuka 'have to' kanye 'need to' ezithatha 'to'). 'Must' ibonisa ukubalulekile okungaphakathi noma okukhulu, 'have to' ukubalulekile okusuka phakathi, kanti 'should' ukukhothalaza. Kwezinye izwi: must not (mustn't) ukuze siphe ukubekwa, don't/doesn't have to ukuze siphe ukungalidingeki, kanti shouldn't ukuze siphe ukukhothalaza okubi. Emibuzweni, siyahloba okhethekayo nomuntu: 'Should I...?' noma 'Do I have to...?'. Asiyathusi 'must' kwesikhathi esidlulileyo; siyathusa 'had to'. 'Have to' siyathusa kwesikhathi esimweni, esidlulileyo (had to) kanye nangosasa (will have to). 'Should' iyalinganisa kwesikhathi esidlulileyo kodwa siyathusa 'should have + past participle' ukuze sbonise ukubuyela emuva, nakhu okwesiqotho sase-B1.

concept_examples.text: You must wear a seatbelt.
I have to go to work at eight.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tuː ɡoʊ tuː wɜːrk æt eɪt/

concept_examples.text: You should drink more water.
She doesn't have to cook tonight.

common_error.wrong: She must to study for the exam.
common_error.correct: She must study for the exam.
common_error.correct_alt: She has to study for the exam.
common_error.explanation: Impazamo ephulaphulwa kakhulu: ukusebenzisa 'to' emva kuka 'must'. Nge-English, amazwi akhethekayo (must, should, can, etc.) athathwa nezwi elingekayo ngaphandle kuka 'to'. Nokho, 'have to' kanye 'need to' zithatha 'to'. Khumbula: 'must' + izwi elingekayo, 'have to' + izwi elingekayo ne- 'to'.

examples.note: Must ibonisa ukubalulekile komuntu noma omoya. Lapha kubonakala ukuthi umthethi uyabeka ukubalulekile.

examples.original: I have to take the bus today.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tuː teɪk ðə bʌs təˈdeɪ/
examples.note: Have to ibonisa ukubalulekile okusuka phakathi, njengomthetho noma isimo.
Ekufakiweni, must kanye have to zifanayo, kodwa must iyabonga noma iyabeka ngamandla.
Should siyathusa ukuze siphe ukukhothalaza noma ukukhothalaza.
Ukuzuziswa okubi yishouldn't, okuthathwa ukuze siphe ukungalidi.
Emibuzweni, should siyabeka phambi komuntu.
Mustn't ibonisa ukubekwa. Iyabeka ngamandla kuneshouldn't.

examples.original: You don't have to arrive early.
examples.note: Don't have to ibonisa ukungalidingeki, iyahlukile ku-mustn't. Lapha akubekwa, kodwa akudingeki.

examples.original: Do I have to pay now?
examples.note: Ukuzibuza ngokubalulekile kuka have to siyathusa do/does + umuntu.

translations.zu: Amazwi akhethekayo: should, must, have to, etc.

title: Reflexive Verbs / I-verb ngokwahlukanisa
bridge: KisiSpaniši siyanatha i-verbs ngokwahlukanisa ngokuvamile (me levanto, me baño), kodwa ngesiNgisi lezi verb asibonakalanga kangakanani. Ngokuvamile, okungesiSpani shiwo ngokwahlukanisa, kusiNgisi kusho ngesiviba esifana (I get up, I shower). Ngaphambi kwesiNgisi, i-pronouns ngokwahlukanisa (myself, yourself, etc.) zisetshenziselwa nje lapho isenzo siyaphindaphinda endaweni, futhi azifani ngokuvamile neshiSpani. Cinga ukungayihambisani kahle 'me' njengo 'me' kusiNgisi, ngenxa yokuthi 'me' yile object eduzile, hhayi yokwahlukanisa.
rule: KusiNgisi, i-verbs ngokwahlukanisa ziyakhiwa ngesiviba + isibhalo ngokwahlukanisa (myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves). Zisetshenziselwa kakhulu lapho umuntu esenza nesamukelayo isenzo. Kodwa ngeminye imikhuba, i-verbs ebangesiSpani ngokwahlukanisa azisetshenziswa ngesibhalo ngokwahlukanisa kusiNgisi: get up, wake up, shave, shower, dress, feel, etc. Izibonelo: I get up at seven (hhayi 'I get myself up'). I feel happy (hhayi 'I feel myself happy'). I-pronouns ngokwahlukanisa zisetshenziselwa futhi ukuze kukhulunywa ngokucacile: I did it myself. Ngokwe-A2, khombisa ngokuvamile: i-verbs zokudla kuzo zuva (get up, wash, dress) nemibhalo efana ne-'enjoy oneself' okanye 'behave oneself'. Khumbula ukuthi 'myself' akasetshenziselwa njengesubject; kusiNgisi siyanatha 'I'.

concept_examples.text: I get up at seven every morning.
concept_examples.translation: Ngivuka ngamashumi amahlanu angasithupha kuzo zuva ngomva.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ɡet ʌp æt ˈsɛvən ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She washes her face before breakfast.
concept_examples.translation: Yena uhleka ubuso bakhe ngaphambi kokudla.

concept_examples.text: He hurt himself while playing football.

common_error.wrong: I wash me in the morning.
common_error.correct: I wash myself in the morning.
common_error.correct_alt: I get washed in the morning.
common_error.explanation: Lolu phutha luyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi kusiSpani siwusho 'me lavo', lapho 'me' yisibhalo ngokwahlukanisa. Kodwa kusiNgisi, 'me' yisibhalo somthetho, hhayi ngokwahlukanisa. Ngokwenzeka ngokwahlukanisa, kumele usebenzise 'myself', 'yourself', etc. Nokho, ngokuvamile asiyisetshenzisanga isibhalo ngokwahlukanisa ne-verbs zokudla kuzo zuva: 'I wash' okanye 'I have a wash' ziyabona kabanzi. Khumbula: lapho isenzo siyabona ngokucacile ngokwahlukanisa, iminye i-verbs ayidingi isibhalo ngokwahlukanisa kusiNgisi: I get dressed, I shave, I shower.

examples.note: KusiNgisi 'wake up' awudingi isibhalo ngokwahlukanisa, kuhambisana nesiSpani.
Siyasetshenzisa 'dress' ngaphandle kwengokwahlukanisa; 'dress herself' iyabona ngokukhulunywa ngokucacile okanye ayibonakalanga kabanzi.
'Shave' ngokuvamile ayidingi ngokwahlukanisa kusiNgisi.

examples.original: He introduced himself to the class.
examples.note: Lapha siyadinga 'himself' ngenxa yokuthi isenzo siyaphindaphinda endaweni.
Siyasetshenzisa 'myself' ukuze sikhandlele ukuthi umuntu ngokwesibonelo nesibhalo.

examples.original: She looked at herself in the mirror.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi lʊkt æt hɜːrˈsɛlf ɪn ðə ˈmɪrər/
examples.note: Ne-verbs efana ne-'look at', ngokwahlukanisa kuyidingeka.
Ngokwahlukanisa kuyakhuluma ngokucacile ukuthi umuntu wenzile ngaphandle kwesize.
'Enjoy oneself' yimbhalo efana eyithi 'ukuba niyavuya'.
'Behave oneself' yimbhalo efana engakho kusiNgisi eyathi 'ukuba njengalokhu'.

title: Object Pronouns / Izibhalo Zokubeka Nesokubekwa
bridge: KisiSpaniši, izibhalo zokubeka nesokubekwa (me, te, lo/la, le, nos, os, les) zihlala ngaphambi kovubi, kodwa ngesiNgisi izibhalo zokubeka (me, you, him, her, it, us, them) ziya ngemva kovubi okanye ngemva kwesiphumo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kisiSpaniši kukhona ukwahlukanisa phakathi kokubeka nokubekwa ngokwaso lo/la nale, kodwa ngesiNgisi kusiwa him/her/them kubombombini, ngaphandle kokubekwa okusegedlela 'to' okanye 'for'. Qaphela: ngesiNgisi awunakususa isibhalo njengokuthi kunzima kusiwa kisiSpaniši, futhi ungasetshenzisi 'lo' njengo 'it' kwezinto zokubeka.
rule: Izibhalo zokubeka ngesiNgisi ziyima: me, you, him, her, it, us, them. Zisetshenziswa ukusetshenziswa esikhundleni somgabho oyingxenye yokubeka (iyamukela umsebenzi) okanye ingxenye yokubekwa (iyamukela ingxenye yokubeka). Ngokuvamile ziya ngemva kovubi (I see him) okanye ngemva kwesiphumo (She gives it to me). Aziguquli ngokwemihla (him/her abantu, it izinto, them abantu abaningi). Ngokwengxenye yokubekwa, ungasetshenzisa umqondo 'verb + object + preposition' (She gave the book to him) okanye 'verb + preposition + object' (She gave him the book). Ngokungaliphansi kweziSpaniši, akusetshenziswa isibhalo esahlukene 'le' nale 'lo'; bobabili beshiwa him okanye her, futhi 'ello' njengo it.

concept_examples.text: I see you every day.
She loves him very much.
Can you give me the book?
We bought them some food.

common_error.wrong: I see her. She is pretty. *I see she.
common_error.correct: I see her. She is pretty.
common_error.explanation: Abasabelo basiSpaniši ngenkathi-ke besetshenzisa izibhalo zomgabho (she, he, they) esikhundleni sezibhalo zokubeka (her, him, them) ngenxa yokuthi kisiSpaniši 'la' nale 'le' ziyafanana. NgesiNgisi, ngemva kovubi kusetshenziswa isibhalo sokubeka: I see her, hhayi I see she. Khumbula: umgabho = she/he/they; okubekwa = her/him/them.

examples.note: NgesiNgisi, 'him' iya ngemva kovubi, ngokungaliphansi kweziSpaniši okuthi 'lo' iya ngaphambi.
Qaphela: 'her' isebenza njengokubeka, hhayi njengokubeka.
KusiSpaniši, 'us' yeshintshwa njengo 'nos' futhi ingahle kelibhalwe phambi kovubi.
NgesiNgisi, okubekwa (me) kungahle kelibhalwe ngaphandle kwesiphumo uma kuya ngaphambi kokubeka.
Lapha 'them' liyafana nale 'les', kodwa ngesiNgisi akukho ukwahlukanisa phakathi kwe 'los/las'.

examples.original: Can you buy her a drink?
examples.note: Bheka umwebo: iverba + okubekwa + okubeka.
Ngemva kwesiphumo 'to', kusetshenziswa 'me', hhayi 'I'.
'You' liyafana ngomgabho nangokubeka, kodwa 'me' nale 'us' ziguqula nesiphumo.
KusiSpaniši 'la' iya ngaphambi kovubi, kodwa ngesiNgisi 'her' iya ngemva kwesiphumo.

title: Frequency Adverbs / Izincazelo Zokudlula
bridge: NesiNgisi, izincazelo zokudlula njengo 'always' noma 'never' zikhona ngaphambi kovubi ('I always eat fruit'), kodwa kusiNgisi kuneziqondo eziphambili: zidinga kuba ngaphambi kovubi oqala ('I always eat fruit') kodwa emva kovubi 'to be' ('I am always happy'). Ngaphezu kwalokho, nesiNgisi singasho 'never' ngaphandle kwesiphambano esisheshile, kodwa kusiNgisi 'never' kuphezu kwalokho, akusetshenziselwa 'don't'.
rule: Izincazelo zokudlula kusiNgisi (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) zibonisa ukuthi isimo sikhona nginkathi. Zikhona: 1) Ngaphambi kovubi oqala: 'She often reads.' 2) Emva kovubi 'to be' (am/is/are): 'He is always late.' 3) Phakathi komsindo nokuvuma emibuzweni nokushaya: 'Do you usually drink coffee?' 'I don't often go out.' Izibopho: 'sometimes' ne 'usually' zingakhona ekuqaleni noma ekupheleni komsindo ukuze kwelekeleke: 'Sometimes I walk to work' / 'I walk to work sometimes'. 'Never', 'rarely' ne 'seldom' zinjalo zingamabala, ngakho-ke azisetshenziselwa 'not'. 'Never' ukuvuma kovubi: 'I never smoke' (hhayi 'I don't never smoke'). Emiphendweni emincane, zikhona ngaphambi komsindo: 'Yes, I usually do'.

concept_examples.text: I always have breakfast at seven.
She is often tired after work.
concept_examples.translation: Yena ngokuvamile uya emsebenzini ngemva kokuxabana.

concept_examples.text: They never watch TV at night.
Do you usually drink coffee?

common_error.explanation: Lolu phutha lweyo kuba nesiNgisi isetshenziswa isiphambano esisheshile ngokomfanekiso ('I don't eat meat never'). KusiNgisi, 'never' njalo ngamabala, ngakho-ke akudingeka 'don't'. Ukusungula, susa umsindo oyingozi futhi usebenzisa 'never' ngokukodwa kovubi. Noma, ungasetshenzisa 'don't ... ever' kodwa akusekho okuningi futhi kwelekeleke.

examples.note: Faka 'always' ngaphambi kovubi oqala 'brush'.

examples.original: He usually plays football on Sundays.
examples.translation: Yena ngokuvamile uya emsebenzini ngemva kokuxabana.
examples.note: 'Usually' kuya ngaphambi kovubi 'plays'.
Incazelo 'often' yekhona ngaphambi kovubi 'visit'.
Emva kovubi 'is', sesetshenzisa 'always'.
'Never' kuya emva kovubi 'am'.

examples.translation: Yena ngokuvamile uya emsebenzini ngemva kokuxabana.
examples.note: Incazelo yekhona emva 'is', ngaphambi kwesiga.

levels.label: Frequency adverbs in questions and negatives

examples.original: Do you often go to the cinema?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː ˈɒfən ɡəʊ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.note: Emibuzweni, incazelo yekhona phakathi komsindo 'do' nokuvuma.

examples.original: I don't usually eat fast food.
examples.note: Nokushaya, 'usually' yekhona phakathi 'don't' nokuvuma.
'Rarely' njalo ngamabala, akudingeka 'don't'.

title: Prepositions of Time / I-Preposition zeZikhathi
bridge: KisiNgisi, i-prepositions zezikhathi (at, in, on) zinekhono eziqondile eziningi alizivikani nesiSpanish. Ngokwesibonelo, sithi 'on Monday' (ngoMsombuluko) futhi 'in the morning' (ekuseni), kodwa 'at night' (ebusuku). IsiSpanish isebenza 'en' okanye 'a' ngokubanzi kunengezi, ngakho-ke kulula ukubhala ngalendlela futhi ukhethe isiphambano. Khumbula: kisiNgisi, yonke ipreposition iyabambisana noma yezihambo eziqondile zezikhathi: i-hours (at), i-days (on), futhi i-months/years/seasons (in).
rule: KisiNgisi, i-prepositions zezikhathi eziqondile ziyinguqulela: 'at' kwe-hours eziqondile futhi i-moments eziqondile (at 5 o'clock, at midnight, at noon), 'on' kwe-days futhi i-dates (on Monday, on July 4th, on my birthday), futhi 'in' kwe-parts of the day (ngaphandle kuka 'at night'), months, years, seasons futhi i-periods elide (in the morning, in July, in 2024, in summer). Akusetshenziselwa ipreposition no- 'today', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow', okanye no- 'this', 'that', 'every', njll. Futhi kusetshenziselwa 'at' kwe-festivities engakwazi 'day' (at Christmas) kodwa 'on Christmas day'.

concept_examples.text: I wake up at seven o'clock.
We have a meeting on Monday.
She goes to the gym in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi goʊz tu ðə dʒɪm ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: They travel in summer.

common_error.wrong: I go to work on the morning.
common_error.correct: I go to work in the morning.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sikhona ngenxa yokuthi isiSpanish sithi 'ekuseni' futhi isifundo esibambisana no- 'ekuseni' no- 'on' (ngoba ngemaribe 'on' iyaguqulwa njengo 'in'). Kodwa kisiNgisi, iparti yosuku (ekuseni, ebusuku) isetshenziselwa no- 'in', ngaphandle kuka 'at night'. Ukuba ufuna ukucula isiphambano, khumbula: 'in' kwe-parts of the day, hhayi 'on'. Dala izibopho njengo 'in the afternoon' futhi 'in the evening'.

examples.phonetic: /ðə klæs stɑrts æt naɪn eɪ ɛm/
examples.note: Sethisa 'at' kwe-hours eziqondile. IsiSpanish isethisa 'a', kodwa ungayiguquli ngokweduzane.

examples.original: She always eats lunch at noon.
examples.note: 'At noon' futhi 'at midnight' yizi-exceptions ezingathathi 'in' okanye 'on'.

examples.original: Let's meet at half past five.
examples.note: Futhi kusetshenziselwa 'at' kwe-expressions zezikhathi njengo 'half past' okanye 'quarter to'.
Sethisa 'on' + usuku nolwimi. IsiSpanish isithi 'el 15 de enero', kodwa kisiNgisi ufuna 'on'.
Sethisa 'on' kwe-days of the week, both singular futhi plural.

examples.original: We have a party on New Year's Eve.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæv ə ˈpɑrti ɑn nu jɪrz iv/
examples.note: Sethisa 'on' lapho umhlangano ubhalwe 'day' okanye 'eve'.

levels.label: In for Months, Years, and Seasons

examples.note: Sethisa 'in' kwe-years. IsiSpanish futhi isethisa 'en', ngakho-ke kulula.
Sethisa 'in' kwe-months. Ungasetshenziseli 'on' nangabe ngu-day eqondile kwenye yinyanga.
Sethisa 'in' kwe-seasons, kodwa ngemaribe kungahlekelwa kisiNgisi esingasi: 'in winter' okanye 'winter'.

examples.original: The store opens in the afternoon.
examples.note: Khumbula: 'in' kwe- 'morning', 'afternoon', 'evening', kodwa 'at' kwe- 'night'.

title: Conjunctions: and, but, or, because, when, if / Izincazelo: futhi, kodwa, noma, ngoba, lapho, uma
bridge: Ngisi-Ngisi, izincazelo ziyasebenza ngendlela efananayo ne-Spanish, kodwa kuneziphambeko eziqakathekile. Ngokwesibonelo, 'kodwa' siyatholakalayo ukuze kufanelekise, njengokuba 'kodwa' kunjalo, kodwa ngisi-Ngisi awusekho 'kodwa' emva koma lapho uyahlanganisela amavesi amabili, ngakho-ke ngesi-Spanish ngokuvamile. Ngaphandle kwalokho, 'ngoba' futhi 'lapho' awudingi ukuba kuma emva komsuka, ngokungalikele ngesi-Spanish. 'Uma' uyavula imiyalo eyodwa, njengokuba 'uma' ngesi-Spanish, kodwa khumbula ukuthi ngisi-Ngisi awusekho ukusetshenziswa kwesubjunctive kule miya loA2.
rule:
Izincazelo ngisi-Ngisi zisetshenziswa ukuze hlanganise amazwi, izinsiza noma amavesi. Ezinaningi kakhulu ziyalokhu: 
- 'futhi' (futhi) ukuze engenise ulwazi.
- 'kodwa' (kodwa) ukuze kufanelekise.
- 'noma' (noma) ukuze nikela izinketho.
- 'ngoba' (ngoba) ukuze nike umbono noma isizathu.
- 'lapho' (lapho) ukuze bonisane isikhathi.
- 'uma' (uma) imiyalo.

Kule misebe, kusetshenziswa ukoma ngaphambi kwesincazelo lapho uyahlanganisela amavesi amabili (ngokwesibonelo: 'Ngiyakuthanda itiye, kodwa yena uyakuthanda ikhofi.'). Nokho, kule misebe emincane awudingeka ngenkathi. 

Izinhlelo eziqakathekile: 
- 'Ngoba' kusetshenziswa ukuphendula imibuzo enomlinganiselo 'ukuthi'. Awusekho 'ngoba' ekuqaleni komsuka ngokomthelela wokukhuluma, kodwa kuhle ngokukhuluma kwezinsuku. 
- 'Lapho' kusetshenziswa imisebenzi eyenzeka ngesikhathi esiqakathekile; ingahamba ekuqaleni noma phakathi komsuka. 
- 'Uma' uyavula umyalo; ekuqaleni komsuka (uma + esikhathini samanje, esizayo), awusekho 'will' esikhundleni 'uma'.

Iziphakamiso: 
- 'Kodwa' awusekho kanye no 'although' kanye, nakhu ngesi-Spanish ungakusho 'kodwa nakhu'. Ngisi-Ngisi, kuhlanganyelwe okunye.
- 'Futhi' kusetshenziswa izahluko; ngaphambi kwesifundo esisodwa ungakususa ukoma, kodwa kusingeke. 
- Ngisi-Ngisi, awusekho 'that' njengesincazelo kulekezi, ngokungalikele ngesi-Spanish (that).

concept_examples.text: I like coffee and tea.
She is tired, but she will come.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈtaɪərd bʌt ʃi wɪl kʌm/

concept_examples.text: Do you want juice or soda?
We stayed home because it was raining.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː steɪd hoʊm bɪˈkɔːz ɪt wɒz ˈreɪnɪŋ/

common_error.wrong: Because I was sick, so I didn't go to work.
common_error.correct: Because I was sick, I didn't go to work.
common_error.correct_alt: I didn't go to work because I was sick.
common_error.explanation: Ngesi-Spanish, kuhle ukusetshenziswa 'ngoba' futhi 'ngakho-ke' kanye, kodwa ngisi-Ngisi 'ngoba' sele iyakhuluma isizathu futhi awudingi 'ngakho-ke' (ngakho-ke). Ukusetshenziswa kwababili kulinganiselwe. Ukuze kuncishisele, khetha isincazelo esodwa: uma usetshenzisa 'ngoba', umsuka oqakathekile uyahamba emva; uma usetshenzisa 'ngakho-ke', isizathu kufanele kube esikhundleni esokuqala. Ngokwesibonelo, 'Ngasekela, ngakho-ke angangeni emsebenzini.'

examples.original: I have a cat and a dog.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kæt ænd ə dɒg/
examples.note: Sethisa 'futhi' ukuze uhlanganise izinto ezimfananayo, njengokuba 'futhi' ngesi-Spanish.

examples.original: He is young but very smart.
examples.note: Sethisa 'kodwa' ukufanelekisa, njengokuba 'kodwa'. Musa ukukhohlwa ukuthi ngisi-Ngisi awusekho ukoma lapha ngoba yimsuka eyodwa.

examples.original: You can have tea or coffee.
examples.note: Sethisa 'noma' ukuze nikela izinketho, efana no 'noma' ngesi-Spanish.

examples.original: She cries because she is happy.
examples.note: Sethisa 'ngoba' ukuze nike umbono. Ngisi-Ngisi, awukho ukoma lapho isikhumbuzo sokuthola siyahamba emva komqondo oqakathekile.
Sethisa 'lapho' isikhathi. Ngisi-Ngisi, isikhathi samanje sisetshenziswa emva kwe 'lapho' esizweni esizayo (awusekho 'uzobiza'), ngokungalikele ngesi-Spanish.

examples.original: When it rains, we stay at home.
examples.phonetic: /wen ɪt reɪnz wiː steɪ æt hoʊm/
examples.note: Lapho 'lapho' iyohamba ekuqaleni, isehlulekela ukoma. Buka ukuthi kusetshenziswa isikhathi samanje ngisi-Ngisi, njengokuba ngesi-Spanish (awusekho 'kuzohlala').

examples.original: If you are tired, go to bed.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː ɑːr ˈtaɪərd ɡoʊ tuː bed/
examples.note: Sethisa 'uma' imiyalo ezinamandla. Isikhumbuzo esine 'uma' singahamba ekuqaleni (noma ukoma) noma ekufeni (noma ukoma).

examples.original: I will come if you invite me.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kʌm ɪf juː ɪnˈvaɪt miː/
examples.note: Ekuqaleni komsuka, esikhundleni 'uma' awudingi 'will' (awusekho ukuthi 'uma uzobiza').

examples.original: If you study, you will pass.
examples.note: Khumbula ukuthi ngisi-Ngisi kusetshenziswa isikhathi samanje ekutholweni, futhi isikhathi esizayo esiphumeleleni. Ngesi-Spanish, ngenkathi kusetshenziswa isikhathi esizayo kumbili, kodwa ngisi-Ngisi hayi.

title: Present Perfect Basics / Isikhathi sasekhono esijwayelekile
bridge: NgesisiZulu, siyaxhosa isikhathi sasekhono esijwayelekile (u-‘have’ + isikhathi esedlule) ukutsho izinto ezenzekile edlule enokuba njengoba zinezinga namuhla. Ngesingalesi, isikhathi sasekhono (I have eaten) sinechwaningerhi efana, kodwa kusetshenziswa nangokubona ukubona izinhlelo zokuphila ngaphandle kokuchaza nini zenzeka, okungokwesisiZulu kuboniswa ngokuthi ‘I ate’. Inye inkinga ebalulekile: ngesingalesi, isikhathi sasekhono asikwazi ukusetshenziswa namagama okwesikhathi edlule anjengokuthi ‘yesterday’ okanye ‘last year’; lapho kunesidingo sokusetshenzisa isikhathi esedlule esihle. Cinga ngendawo yokuthi ‘already’, ‘just’ ne-‘yet’, okungakafani ngesisiZulu.
rule: Isikhathi sasekhono siyakusakwa ngokushiyela isikhathi sasekhono (have/has) + isikhathi esedlule esikhona. Ngezikhathi eziyinhloko, isikhathi esedlule siyafana nesikhathi esedlule esihle (ukuphela -ed: work -> worked). Ngezikhathi ezingahlokosekile, kunesidingo sokufunda isikhathi esedlule (go -> gone, see -> seen). Kusetshenziswa: 1) Ukutsho izinhlelo zokuphila ngaphandle kokuchaza isikhathi (e.g., I have visited Paris). 2) Izenzo zedlule enokuba njengoba zinezinga namuhla (e.g., I have lost my keys). 3) Namagama ‘already’ (kanye), ‘just’ (kancane), ‘yet’ (ngisho) emibuzweni nasecalweni. 4) No-‘for’ ne-‘since’ ukutsho isikhathi (e.g., I have lived here for 10 years). Emibuzweni, siyabeka isikhathi sasekhono ngokuqala: Have you finished? Nasecalweni: I have not (haven't) finished. Khumbula ukuthi no-‘yesterday’, ‘last week’ n.a., kusetshenziswa isikhathi esedlule esihle, hhayi isikhathi sasekhono.

concept_examples.text: I have eaten breakfast.
She has visited Mexico.
We haven't finished our homework yet.
Have you ever seen a shark?

common_error.explanation: NgesisiZulu sithi ‘ngiyibone izolo’, kodwa ngesingalesi isikhathi sasekhono asikwazi ukusetshenziswa namagama okwesikhathi edlule anjengokuthi ‘yesterday’. Ukubeka isenzo ngesikhathi esiphelile, kusetshenziswa isikhathi esedlule esihle (saw). Uma usetshenzisa ‘have seen’ ngaphandle kokuchaza isikhathi, kuyisikhathi esihle ukutsho ukubona.

examples.note: Bona ukuthi ‘have’ kusakwa ku-‘I've’ ngesikhathi sasekhono: I've finished.
Sisetshenzisa ‘has’ ngomuntu omunye (he, she, it).
Isicalo siyakusakwa ngo-‘haven't’ (have not) okanye ‘hasn't’ (has not).
Emibuzweni, buyisela umuntu nomsebenzi: Have you...?
Asisabi nini sahamba; isihloko siyisihloko.
Isikhathi esedlule saso-‘eat’ asihlokosekile: ‘eaten’.

examples.original: Have you ever seen a ghost?
examples.note: Kusetshenziswa ‘ever’ emibuzweni ukubuza ngizinhlelo.
Iphumlo siyibalulekile namuhla: manje angikubona.
‘Just’ siyabekwa phakathi kwesikhathi sasekhono nesisekelo.

examples.original: I have lived here for five years.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lɪvd hɪr fɔːr faɪv jɪrz/
examples.note: Sisetshenzisa ‘for’ ukutsho isikhathi (isikhathi esiphelile).

title: Imperatives (Affirmative and Negative) / Isicelo (okuhambisana nokuba okungahambisani)
bridge: NgesisiZulu, isicelo sineendlela ezahlukahlukene ukuba lisele kuwe, wena, thina, nina, etc. NgesiNgisi, isicelo kulisekudluliswa ngokukhulu: usebenzisa isimo somsebenzi womshumayeli ngokuvamile, ngakhathesi ukuthi uyakhuluma nani. Ngokwesibonelo, 'habla' (tú) futhi 'hable' (usted) ngesiNgisi kulisekudluliswa nje 'speak'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukuze ungavumi, ngesiNgisi usebenzisa 'don't' + ishumayeli, ngakho-ke ngesiZulu usebenzisa 'no' + isicelo. Qaphela: awusebenzisi 'doesn't' nabashumayeli; usebenzisa 'don't' kubo bonke.
rule: Isicelo ngesiNgisi isakhiwa neshumayeli esisimweni sakhe (ukungabi nomsebenzi 'to'). Isetshenziswa ukuze nicheze, imiyalo, izilathiso okanye izinhlamvu. Izibonelo: 'Open the door', 'Listen to me'. Ukusetshenziswa kwesicelo esingavumelekayo, 'don't' (okanye 'do not' ngokomthetho) ikhona ngaphambi kweshumayeli esisimweni: 'Don't open the door', 'Don't worry'. Akukho uhlukile phakathi kwe-singular ne-plural okanye phakathi kwe-formal ne-informal. Ukuze ukhombise izinhlamvu (e.g., 'Let's go'). NgesiNgisi, ngenhlukaniso yesiZulu, awusetshenziswa isicelo ukuze ubeke amalungelo (njengokuthi 'que te mejores'), ukuze wenze lokho usetshenzisa izinhlaka ezinye.

concept_examples.text: Open the window, please.
Don't touch that!
Let's go to the park.
Please, close the door.

common_error.explanation: Abantu abakhuluma isiZulu bavela ekuvulekeni 'to' emva kwesicelo 'don't' ngenxa yezifiso zesiZulu (ukungabi nomsebenzi). NgesiNgisi, emva kwesicelo 'don't' usetshenziswa isimo somsebenzi womshumayeli ngokuvamile ngaphandle kwesicelo 'to'.

examples.note: Isicelo sesetshenziswa ngokuvamile ngaphandle kweshumayeli. NgesiZulu, 'siéntate' sine Shumayeli esihlanganiswe.
Isicelo sesetshenziswa singafani nge-tú futhi nge-usted. Buka ukuthi 'listen' awunelisiquba 'to' phambi kwaso esicelo.
Ishumayeli 'come' isetshenziswa esisimweni sakhe. NgesiZulu, 'venir' ineendlela ezahlukahlukene, kodwa ngesiNgisi hayi.
Ukuze ungavumi, usetshenziswa 'don't' phambi kweshumayeli esisimweni. NgesiZulu usetshenziswa 'no' + isicelo.
Nangona 'be' yishumayeli esihambisana, esicelo esingavumelekayo sesetshenziswa 'don't be'.
Khumbula ukuthi 'worry' yishumayeli eyisimo; awudingeki 'to'.
'Let's' yisikhombisi sokuqeda 'let us'. Isetshenziswa ukuze ukhombise izinhlamvu ekhombisa abantu abaningi abahlanganyela nokukhuluma.
NgesiZulu usetshenziswa isiqingatha (veamos) okanye 'vamos a ver', kodwa ngesiNgisi usetshenziswa 'let's' + ishumayeli esisimweni.
Isimo esingavumelekayo sokuqeda 'let's' yisokuqeda 'let's not + ishumayeli'. Yisikhi sephula kwesiko esijwayelekile.

title: Count and Uncount Nouns / Izibambo eziqabelayo nezingeziqabeli
bridge: NgisiZulu, ukuxelelwa phakathi kwesiqabelayo nangesiqabeli kusekho kodwa akusisekelwe kakhulu. Ngokwesibonelo, siyi 'izonka' ukubala amakhanda ezinkwa, ngakho-ke ngesiNgisi 'bread' ayiqabelwa futhi ayihlukahlulwa. Inye yezithathu ezibalulekile: izibambo eziqabelayo ngesiNgisi azisebenzisi 'a/an' noma 'one', kodwa ngesiZulu ngenkathi-ke yini, njengokuthi 'isinqathi esisodwa' esingesiNgisi kuba yisithi 'some information'.
rule: NgesiNgisi, izibambo eziqabelayo (count nouns) zingahamba ngesincedi noma ngesiporoshiyeni futhi zingabalwa (one apple, two apples). Izibambo eziqabelayo (uncount nouns) azinaporoshiyeni futhi azibalwa ngokwedlula (water, rice, information). Ukubala iziqabelayo, kusetshenziswa 'some', 'any', 'much', noma izindingo njengokuthi 'a glass of' noma 'a piece of'. Ngezibambo eziqabelayo kusetshenziswa 'a/an' ukusinceda, 'many' ukuporoshiyeni, futhi 'few' ukubala ambalwa. Ngezibambo eziqabelayo kusetshenziswa 'much' futhi 'little'. Izibopho eziqinisekile 'the' zisetshenziswa ngendlela efananayo, kodwa eziqhubekayo ziguqulwa: 'a/an' azisetshenziswa ngezibambo eziqabelayo. Izimpawu: ezinye izibambo zingaba ziqabelayo noma zingesiqabeli ngokomthelela (e.g., 'chicken' njengensimbi vs. njengenkwa).

concept_examples.text: I need some water.
She has two apples.
Do you have any information?
He bought a piece of bread.

common_error.wrong: I have a good news for you.
common_error.correct: I have good news for you.
common_error.correct_alt: I have some good news for you.
common_error.explanation: NgesiNgisi, 'news' ayiqabelwa, ngakho-ke 'a' ayisekho. Abafundi abashiZulu baya phuthuma ngoba ngesiZulu siyi 'isinqathi esisodwa'. Ukusungula, sebenzisa 'some' noma 'news' ngaphandle kwesibopo.

examples.note: Sebenzisa 'a' phambi kwesandi sesikhombisa.
Sebenzisa isiporoshiyeni '-s' ukubala.
Sebenzisa 'an' phambi kwesandi lesihlamvu.
'Water' aynaporoshiyeni.
Sebenzisa 'some' ukubala okungaziqinisekile.
Sebenzisa 'any' emibuzweni.

examples.original: I need a glass of milk.
examples.note: Ukubala iziqabelayo, sebenzisa isidingo + 'of'.

examples.original: She has a lot of friends.
examples.note: 'A lot of' kusetshenziswa ngezibambo eziqabelayo nezingeziqabeli.

examples.note: 'Little' ukubala iziqabelayo, 'few' ukubala izibambo eziqabelayo.

title: Some and Any / Some no Any (kanye nabo amanye)
bridge: NesiNgisi, sizathatha 'something', 'somebody' okanye 'nothing' ngaphandle kokubhekana phakathi kwezifundo eholwayo nenzani okanye imibuzo. Kulo Mzansi, ukuthetha phakathi kuka 'some' no 'any' kulinganiselwa umthelela wengoma nokuthinta komthethi. Isikhubekiso esikhulu kumaSpane sizokusebenzisa 'some' emibuzweni no 'any' eholwayeni ngenxa yokuthinta komthethi weSpani, kodwa kulo Mzansi umthelela ungabambisana. Ngaphandle kwalokho, 'any' eholwayeni kuhamba isisho ku 'anyone'.
rule: Sizokusebenzisa 'some' (kanye nabo amanye: somebody, someone, something, somewhere) eholwayeni nasemibuzweni lapho siyabiza okanye sicela ngokumncono, okanye lapho sikholelwa isiphetho esiholwayo. Sizokusebenzisa 'any' (kanye nabo amanye: anybody, anyone, anything, anywhere) eholwayeni enkulu nasemibuzweni enkulu, kanye eholwayeni esholwa ukuthi 'anyone' okanye 'doesn't matter who'. Amanye ahlala nalomthelela: something/anything, somebody/anybody, someone/anyone, somewhere/anywhere. Ngesinombolo esibalulekileyo sizokusebenzisa 'some' neplural no 'any' neplural; nangesinombolo esingabalulekileyo sizokusebenzisa 'some' okanye 'any' ngokomthelela. Asizokusebenzisa 'no' no 'any' kuyo enye ingoma; sizokusebenzisa 'no' + isinombolo okanye 'not... any'.

concept_examples.text: I have some money in my wallet.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv sʌm ˈmʌni ɪn maɪ ˈwɔːlɪt/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any questions?

Sizokusebenzisa 'any' negoduza, okanye singahletha 'no' phambi kwesinombolo ukuze sikhombise ukuthi akukho. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi 'some' sikahlelwe ukusebenziswa eholwayeni nasemibuzweni okanye ukubiza.

levels.translation: Some no Any nesinombolo esibalulekileyo nangasinombolo esingabalulekileyo

examples.note: Isinombolo esibalulekileyo neplural. Kulo Mzansi 'algunas' isebenza kahle eholwayeni.

examples.note: 'Any' eholwayeni = 'anyone', akusabalulekile ophanayo.
I- 'anybody' nezinga elingu 'anyone'.

title: Much, Many, A lot of / Izingqalisi
bridge: Ngesi, siyaqhubeka 'much' noma 'many' kuhlukaniswa ngenhlamba nombolo, kodwa ngesi ukhetha kuhlukaniswa ngokuthi isibhalo singabakho noma asikho, hhayi ngenhlamba. Oku kungaba khumbula ngokuqala, kodwa kunzima: 'many' kuzo zonke izinto ongazibala (nje. ibhuku), 'much' kuzo zonke izinto ongazibala (nje. amanzi), futhi 'a lot of' kuzo zobili izindawo. Isiphambano esijwayelekile ukusebenzisa 'much' nezibhalo ezingabakho eziqinisekile, kodwa khumbula ukuthi 'much' no 'many' zisebenziselwa kakhulu ezingamanisweni nasemibuzweni.
rule: Ngesi, izingqalisi 'much', 'many' no 'a lot of' zikhombisa inani. 'Many' sisetshenziswa nezibhalo ezingabakho eziqedi (ibhuku, amakhulu, abangane). 'Much' sisetshenziswa nezibhalo ezingabakho (amanzi, isikhathi, imali). Emizuzweni eqinisekile, kunjalo ukusetshenziswa 'a lot of' (noma 'lots of' endleleni yokukhuluma) kuzo zobili izinhlobo zebhalo. Ezingamanisweni nasemibuzweni, sisetshenzisa 'much' no 'many'. Nge- 'how much' siye sa buza ngenani yezinto ezingabakho (How much water?), futhi nge- 'how many' siye sa buza ngenani yezinto ezingabakho (How many books?). Awusetshenziswa 'much' noma 'many' nezibhalo eziqedi. Futhi kunezinkulumo eziqondile njengokuthi 'too much', 'too many', 'so much', 'so many'. Eziqinisekile, 'much' iyafomali noma iyakhombisa (There is much work). Kwa A2, kudingeka ukubekezelela ukusetshenziswa kwemibuzo nasemibuzweni, futhi ukusetshenzisa 'a lot of' eziqinisekile. Khumbula ukuthi 'much' no 'many' awusetshenziswa 'no' ngendlela efanayo (usetshenzisa 'not much' noma 'not many').

concept_examples.text: I have a lot of friends.

There aren't many cars in the street.

Nokho, ngesi, 'much' awusetshenziswa nezibhalo ezingabakho eziqinisekile. Ukusungula, khumbula: eziqinisekile, usetshenzisa 'a lot of' kuzo zobili izinhlobo, noma 'many' uma ufuna ukuba ufomali. title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that / Iziga zokubandakanya: who, which, that
bridge: Ngesi, siyaxusa 'that' kubantu nakho konke, futhi ngemarhu 'who' kubantu. Ngesi, kufanele ukhethe phakathi kwesethu 'who' (kubantu) no 'which' (izinto), nankuna 'that' singasetshenziswa kubombini ezinye izikhathi. Qaphela: ngesi, isiboniso sokaqhubeka asinakususa uma kulesibhalo, kodwa ngesi ngemarhu kungaba yimbi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesi, asisetshenziswa 'what' kokaqhubeka (lokhu kuhlala yinkombiso ephulwe abashengisayo isiHispani); setshenziswa 'that' okanye 'which'.
rule:
Iziga zokubandakanya zisebenza ukubandakanya amacebo amabili ngendoda okanye into eyodwa. Ngesi, siyaxusa:

- **who** kubantu (isibhalo okanye into)
- **which** kuzo zonke izinto, amahloni okanye amacebo
- **that** kusetshenziswa kubantu nezinto, ikakhulu ezigabheni eziqinisekile (ezingezanga).

Isimo esisodwa ngukuthi: [igama] + [isiboniso sokaqhubeka] + [isiga].

Izibonelo:
- Indoda **who** ehlala phambi kwami ingumfokazi. (Indoda eyahlala phambi kwami ingumfokazi.)
- Incwadi **which** ngiyithengele iyabangela. (Incwadi engiyithengele iyabangela.)
- Umhloni **that** uyakhala kangaka ungowami. (Umhloni oyakhalayo kangaka ungowami.)

**Iziphakamiso eziqondene nabashengisayo isiHispani:**
- Ungasetshenzisi 'what' njengokaqhubeka (ngesi 'what' kuthi 'lokho okungukuthi' futhi kusetshenziswa ngaphandle kwesiboniso).
- Ungahluki 'who/which/that' uma kulesibhalo, ngenxa yokuthi isibhalo kudingeka.
- Khumbula ukuthi ngesi isimo ngukuthi isibhalo + isibhalo, akuseke ukubhekana njengesi (okubonakala 'Indoda eyahlala lapha' -> 'The man who lives here', hhayi 'The man who here lives').

**Izimo nezacaciso:** Akukho izacaciso. 'That' singasetshenziswa kubantu nezinto. 'Who' kubantu kuphela. 'Which' kuzo zonke izinto. Ngesi esesha, 'that' kuhlala yisebenzisiwe ngokufana, kodwa 'who' no 'which' zihlala zifana.

examples.note: Lapha 'which' iyinto, kodwa kusetshenziswa, akususiwe.

examples.original: The cat that is on the table is black.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kæt ðæt ɪz ɒn ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪz blæk/
examples.note: 'That' singasetshenziswa kubantu nezinto, futhi kubantu.

examples.original: The boy that you met is my cousin.
examples.phonetic: /ðə bɔɪ ðæt juː mɛt ɪz maɪ ˈkʌzən/
examples.note: 'That' seyisebenza kubantu esikhundleni 'who', ikakhulu ngesi esifana.
